# Matthew Cuthbert

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty years old upon Anne's arrival; died a few years later.  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c25 P28](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0028), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P3](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0003), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c37 P21](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Matthew was an odd-looking man with an ungainly figure, stooping shoulders, and long iron-gray hair touching his shoulders. He wore a full, soft brown beard continuously after turning twenty. In his older years, his graying hair framed a placid and kindly face.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c37 P11](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0011)_

## Personality

Extremely shy, quiet, and reserved, Matthew hated going among strangers or speaking to women, dreading that they were secretly laughing at him. Despite his dread of women and children, he was deeply sympathetic, kindhearted, and gentle. He possessed a quiet, silent persistency when attached to an idea and proved to be immensely generous and appreciative toward Anne.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c4 P26](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0026), [v1 c24 P17](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0017)_

- To adopt a young orphan boy to help him work the farm  <sub>[v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c6 P3](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0003)</sub>

## History

Matthew Cuthbert lived at Green Gables with his sister Marilla. Deciding to adopt a young boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm work, Matthew drove to Bright River station only to find eleven-year-old Anne Shirley waiting instead. Despite his severe shyness around women and girls, he immediately took a liking to her talkative, imaginative nature during the drive home and silently advocated for keeping her. Matthew quietly supported Anne throughout her upbringing, buying her a fashionable puff-sleeved dress for Christmas and encouraging her studies. Over time, he suffered from heart trouble while continuing to work the farm. After Anne won the Avery Scholarship, Matthew suffered a fatal shock upon reading news of the Abbey Bank's total failure and collapsed on the doorstep. He was buried in the poplar-shaded Avonlea graveyard, where Anne continued to visit his grave regularly.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P20](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0020), [v1 c2 P7](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0007), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P61](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0061), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c25 P4](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0004), [v1 c25 P35](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0035), [v1 c36 P28](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0028), [v1 c36 P41](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0041), [v1 c37 P1](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0001), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009), [v2 c15 P0](../source/v02-c15.md#nw-v02-c15-p0000), [v4 c3 P57](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0057)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Green Gables, built by his shy father at the edge of the cleared land  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Maintained the same appearance from age twenty through age sixty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
- Never went courting or pursued romantic relationships  <sub>[v1 c18 P13](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0013)</sub>
- Kept all life savings in the Abbey Bank due to loyalty to its founder  <sub>[v1 c36 P34](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0034)</sub>
